The country with the highest global development resilience score in 2020 can be determined using a SQL query to select the maximum score and its corresponding country.

Here's the corrected query:

```sql
SELECT "Country", MAX("Development Resilience Score")
FROM "Global Development Indicators"
WHERE Year = 2020
ORDER BY "Development Resilience Score" DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

This query will return the name of the country with the highest resilience score from 2020, along with its score.
